selection_method: Pages were chosen by inspecting actual page content (ground-truth statistics + direct visual inspection of every image) against the five difficulty classes required by the protocol. Pages are fixed across all models and remain part of the official 462-page benchmark.

pages.selection_reason: Clean Arabic text: born-digital-style printed religious text with full diacritics, headers, and inline colored emphasis; moderate length (2184 GT chars).
pages.difficulty_characteristics: clean print; heavy diacritics; inline color emphasis; single column

pages.selection_reason: Medium-quality scan: scanned administrative cover form with bilingual (Arabic/French) letterheads, stamps, handwritten signature overlap, and form fields.
pages.difficulty_characteristics: scanner noise; stamps and signature over text; bilingual headers; form layout

pages.selection_reason: Difficult/low-resolution scan: dense table-of-contents page at only 483x712 px with dot leaders and Arabic-Indic numerals; longest GT (5562 chars) on the smallest image in the benchmark.
pages.difficulty_characteristics: very low resolution relative to content; dot leaders; dense vertical list; Arabic-Indic page numbers

pages.selection_reason: Complex layout: four separate data tables on a colored gradient background plus centered prose below.
pages.difficulty_characteristics: multiple tables; colored background; no grid lines in upper tables; mixed numeric/text cells

pages.selection_reason: Representative benchmark page: dense two-column academic article mixing running text, two multi-row tables with percentage figures, and Latin-script headers/footers.
pages.difficulty_characteristics: two-column flow; interleaved tables and prose; mixed Arabic/Latin; percentages and Arabic-Indic digits
